title: When Engagement Is Not Enough: What Should AI Optimize in Gamified Education?
description: In crossover STEAM education (n = 49), interest favored gamified instruction (dz = 0.64), whereas perceived expression acquisition favored conventional instruction (dz = -0.55). In disaster education (n = 37), engagement was high and perceived knowledge and competence increased, but intention changed little.
